trello.name: Implement queue depth alert for all worker fleets
trello.desc: Kofi will implement an alert on queue depth for all worker fleets with thresholds set at warning for 1,000 jobs and page at 5,000 jobs to reduce blind spots in monitoring.

trello.name: Fix retry logic with exponential backoff and dead-letter queue
trello.desc: Marta will fix the retry logic in payment_worker.py by implementing exponential backoff with jitter, capping retries, and ensuring failed jobs go to a dead-letter queue at the back of the queue instead of the front. She will also add tests simulating processor 503 errors to cover this scenario.

trello.name: Increase and split DB connection pools
trello.desc: Kofi will increase the database connection pool size from 20 to 100 and split the worker and API connection pools in one configuration change to prevent exhaustion during worker pile-ups.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Priya will update the payment incident runbook to replace old Kibana links with new logging links, document the queue drain procedure used during the outage, and verify and update escalation phone numbers to ensure accuracy.

trello.name: Automate status page updates for checkout errors
trello.desc: Marta will automate the status page updates to switch to 'investigating' automatically when the checkout error rate alert fires, using the status provider's API to reduce manual delays in customer communication.

trello.name: Plan and review payment processor failover game day
trello.desc: Kofi will lead drafting a game day plan to test payment processor failover in staging and production with a rollback plan. The draft will be reviewed in two weeks before execution to ensure preparedness.

trello.name: Schedule Redis upgrade to version 7.2
trello.desc: Kofi will schedule an upgrade of Redis from version 6.0 (EOL) to 7.2, accounting for configuration renames and persistence default changes, and plan the upgrade during a proper change window coordinated with the infrastructure calendar.
